title: Tied to love; lied through Eyes who shove truth above in gloves who hold An iris scoops of Light, that fills two souls As I question candles Who knows
summary: Tied to love; lied through Eyes who shove truth above in gloves who hold An iris scoops of Light, that fills two souls As I question candles Who knows Wicks fading in past glow Will always extinguish Us. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Tied to love;
lied through
Eyes who shove
truth above in
gloves who hold
An iris scoops of
Light,
that fills two souls
As I question candles
Who knows
Wicks fading in past glow
Will always extinguish

Us.

#smallpoems
